plans.proTip.gobletSquat: Keep your chest tall and sit back into the hips.
plans.proTip.benchPress: Use a full controlled descent and strong lockout.
plans.proTip.latPulldown: Focus on squeezing the lats at the bottom.
plans.proTip.lateralRaise: Keep a slight elbow bend and raise to shoulder height.
plans.proTip.bicepCurl: Control the descent and avoid swinging.
plans.proTip.hyperextension: Use a slow tempo and keep the spine neutral.
plans.proTip.crunch: Breathe out as you curl and keep the lower back grounded.
plans.proTip.pullUp: Pull your chest to the bar and avoid excessive kip.
plans.proTip.legPress: Drive through your heels and control the return.
plans.proTip.dumbbellShoulderPress: Press in a smooth line and keep the core tight.
plans.proTip.seatedCableRow: Lead with your elbows and keep the shoulder blades engaged.
plans.proTip.dip: Lower until your elbows form about 90 degrees.
plans.proTip.standingCalfRaise: Pause at the top and stretch the calves fully down.
plans.proTip.plank: Maintain a straight line from head to heels.
plans.proTip.overheadPress: Brace the core and press the bar over mid-foot.
plans.proTip.inclineDumbbellPress: Keep the elbows slightly below shoulder level.
plans.proTip.tricepsPushdown: Keep the elbows pinned and press all the way down.
plans.proTip.cableLateralRaise: Move through the shoulder and keep tension on the delts.
plans.proTip.barbellRow: Keep your back flat and pull the bar to the lower ribs.
plans.proTip.dumbbellRow: Support yourself with the opposite arm and drive the elbow back.
plans.proTip.facePull: Pull the rope to your forehead with external rotation.
plans.proTip.barbellCurl: Keep the elbows stable and avoid rocking.
plans.proTip.squat: Drive through the heels and push the knees out.
plans.proTip.romanianDeadlift: Hinge from the hips and feel the stretch in the hamstrings.
plans.proTip.legExtension: Control the lift and avoid locking the knee aggressively.
plans.proTip.legCurl: Keep the hips down and squeeze the hamstrings at the top.
plans.proTip.hangingLegRaise: Use the core to lift, not momentum.
